camel_example: aliyun hbr UpgradeBackupClients --region cn-hangzhou --CrossAccountUserId 1283948272 --CrossAccountRoleName hbrcrossrole --CrossAccountType CROSS_ACCOUNT --InstanceIds '["c-000000000000000000000"]' --ClientIds '["i-0xi5wj0000003j3bh2gj5"]'
description_en: Upgrades an HBR client on one or more Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances
description_zh: 为一台或者多台ECS实例升级备份客户端
kebab_example: aliyun hbr upgrade-backup-clients --instance-ids '[c-000000000000000000000]' --client-ids '[i-0xi5wj0000003j3bh2gj5]' --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 1283948272 --cross-account-role-name hbrcrossrole --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeBackupClients

parameters.help_en: The IDs of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances. The total number of ECS instance IDs and Cloud Backup client IDs cannot exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: ECS实例ID。ECS实例ID与备份客户端ID数量之和不能超过100个
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of Cloud Backup clients. The total number of Cloud Backup client IDs and ECS instance IDs cannot exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: 备份客户端ID。备份客户端ID与ECS实例ID数量之和不能超过100个
parameters.name: client_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份功能中的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the call is successful

InstanceStatuses.description_en: The status of the ECS instance. If the status of an ECS instance cannot meet the requirements to install an HBR client and the value of the InstanceIds parameter is greater than 1, an error message is returned based on the value of this parameter
InstanceStatuses.description_zh:
ECS实例状态。
若存在ECS实例状态不满足安装客户端的需求，且请求中InstanceIds多于1个时，通过这个字段返回错误信息

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code that is returned. Valid values:

If the value is empty, the call is successful.
InstanceNotExists: The ECS instance does not exist.
InstanceNotRunning: The ECS instance is not running.
CloudAssistNotRunningOnInstance: Cloud Assistant is unavailable
ErrorCode.description_zh:
返回错误码。取值范围：

空表示成功。
InstanceNotExists表示ECS实例不存在。
InstanceNotRunning表示ECS实例未处于Running状态。
CloudAssistNotRunningOnInstance表示云助手不可用

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

ValidInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether an HBR client can be installed on the ECS instance. Valid values:

true: An HBR client can be installed on the ECS instance.
false: An HBR client cannot be installed on the ECS instance
ValidInstance.description_zh:
ECS实例是否可以安装备份客户端。

true表示可以安装。
false表示不可以安装

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the call is successful, "successful" is returned. If the call fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous job. You can call the DescribeTask operation to query the execution result of an asynchronous job
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。可以通过调用DescribeTask获取任务结果
